BiblicalUsage: Madness is a curse Moses warns of, a judgment Zechariah promises for the horses of the nations, and the word for Jehu's furious driving as he comes to Jezreel. In each place it is not sickness alone but a mind given over, driving hard toward its own end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe madness here is what happens when God hands a man over to the way he has chosen. I hold that the mind is a gift to be guarded, and the madness of the Bible is a warning to keep it sober and set on Him.
